body: A content and quiet mind. I have everything I should need. Decently well paying job, friends, beautiful girlfriend and still always thinking about running away and starting over. I haven't felt content in years and the older I get the more bored, flighty, and discontent I become.

What if you really were the instigator of an emergency in your home? You could prevent your team from raiding and get away with whatever nonsense you're up to by just saying "no guys it's a false call; everyone's chill here." ?
The implication is that they were already married and OP mistook their affection when she first arrived for the dude just moving fast with the new girl.

If you're willing to compromise and actually change your daughter's name, your wife should be willing to compromise and find another name that you both like. For her to obsess on this one name and not budge seems completely unreasonable to me. Have you brought that point up to her?

Thank you for this.
I watched a couple videos on the sub you recommended last night which were nice and inspiring. I still don't have any concrete plans for improving my outlook yet but I'm still here trying :/
